## Workload

Daniel Roche completed 952 reads during the quarter, recording 450 hours of work. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was completed within the established session pattern, with activity distributed across the review period. The recorded output provides a clear basis for assessing both the volume of work undertaken and the time required to complete it.

## Quality

A sample of 72 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The resulting agreement rate was 80.6 per cent. This provides an indication of consistency between the original work and the subsequent review. The grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern while continuing to monitor workload and quality through routine review.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Daniel Roche identified as the grader.
